_about: Hero-shot rules for the gallery simulator (issue #31). This file is data, not code: it is the only place in
the lane where a class name is written down, and every name here is checked against galaxus.data.classes when
it loads. Each entry carries a status: 'known' means the hosts said it, with the source; 'assumption' means we
chose it and it must be confirmed. Nothing marked 'assumption' may be presented to anyone as a fact.
